text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Streamlined corporate tax proposal gets cold shoulder in industry, legislature.
Police blitz attack on organised crime in Kaohsiung city.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Taiwan to fight for fishing rights near disputed islands. Talks with Japan begin on Friday.
President Li Teng-hui presses urgency of Taiwan's accession to World Trade Organisation.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Finance Ministry backs down on new corporate tax proposal.
U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan invited to economic forum in Taipei.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Unified corporate tax proposal put on hold.
Two Taiwan life insurers invest in high-tech stocks.
